title: Extra-Principal Payments Counted for the Catch-Up Credit on Plans That Fall Behind
content:
Patient Services Academy — training note on **Patient Payment Plans** plans that have fallen behind more than once, and the extra-principal payments the catch-up credit counts on them.

## The rule

Which of the extra-principal payments posted against the latest missed installment the catch-up credit counts depends on how often the plan has fallen behind:

- on a plan with 2 or more installments recorded missed less than 12 whole months before today **whose installments are drawn automatically from a bank account**, only the largest single one of them;
- on a plan with 2 or more installments recorded missed in that span **whose installments are not drawn automatically from a bank account**, only the most recent one of them;
- on any other plan, all of them.

"Drawn automatically from a bank account" means the plan has automatic payments set up and the method on file for the automatic draws is bank transfer (ACH). A plan with no automatic payments, or with automatic draws from a credit or debit card, is a plan whose installments are not drawn automatically from a bank account.

The count of installments recorded missed is taken from the missed-installment lines on the plan ledger dated less than 12 whole months before today.

## Truth table

| Missed-installment lines in the last 12 whole months | Automatic draws from a bank account | Payments counted |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | Yes | The largest single extra-principal payment against the latest missed installment |
| 2 or more | No (card draws, or no automatic payments) | The most recent extra-principal payment against the latest missed installment |
| 0 or 1 | Yes | All of them |
| 0 or 1 | No | All of them |

## Questions answered (hypothetical plans)

Each plan below carries three extra-principal payments against its latest missed installment, posted in this order: 40.00, 15.00, 25.00.

**A plan drawn by bank transfer with 3 missed-installment lines in the last 12 whole months — what is counted?** Only the largest single one: 40.00.

**A plan paid manually with 2 missed-installment lines in that span?** Only the most recent one: 25.00.

**A plan drawn from a debit card with 2 missed-installment lines in that span?** The debit card is not a bank account, so only the most recent one: 25.00.

**A plan drawn by bank transfer with a single missed-installment line in that span?** All of them: 80.00.

**A plan with 2 missed-installment lines, one of them dated 13 whole months ago?** Only one line falls in the span, so all of them are counted: 80.00.
